Your place, cleaned like it matters

An apartment or condo doesn't need less care just because it has fewer rooms. Kitchens in small spaces work hard, one bathroom gets used by everyone, and dust shows up fast when everything is close together. We clean apartments, condos, lofts and townhomes for renters and owners who want their place to feel fresh without spending a day off scrubbing it.

We're a locally owned Richardson company, so apartment cleaning in Richardson is right in our backyard, from the UT Dallas area to CityLine. We also clean apartments and condos all over Dallas–Fort Worth, from Plano and Uptown Dallas to Fort Worth.

"It's always a great feeling after she's done cleaning our living space to know that it's been thoroughly swept, wiped, dusted, and vacuumed to perfection. Highly recommend!" — Tom R., recurring client (Yelp review)

Your apartment and condo cleaning checklist

Kitchen

  • Countertops, backsplash and sink cleaned and sanitized
  • Stovetop and appliance exteriors wiped
  • Microwave wiped inside and out
  • Cabinet fronts and handles wiped
  • Trash emptied

Bathroom

  • Toilet, tub and shower cleaned and sanitized
  • Sink, counter, mirror and fixtures polished
  • Floor cleaned

Living room and bedrooms

  • Reachable surfaces dusted
  • Mirrors and glass cleaned
  • Beds made
  • Light tidy of surfaces

Floors throughout

  • Carpets and rugs vacuumed
  • Hard floors vacuumed and mopped

Add-ons: inside the oven, inside the refrigerator, inside cabinets, interior windows and laundry. For a top-to-bottom reset with baseboards and ceiling fans, book a deep clean.

Moving in or moving out?

Apartments and condos change hands all the time, especially around UT Dallas and the big complexes along Central Expressway. Our move-in / move-out cleaning covers the inside of every cabinet, the oven, the fridge, the baseboards and the shower glass, the spots a leasing office checks at the walkthrough. Book it for after the movers leave and before your inspection.

Made for building life

  • Gate codes, parking and elevators. Add your building access, parking instructions and unit number to your booking notes so we can get in without a hassle.
  • Pets in the unit. Lots of apartments come with a cat or a small dog. We're pet-friendly and use eco-friendly, pet-safe products.
  • Roommates. Tell us which rooms are shared and which are off limits.
  • Condo owners. If you own your unit, a recurring plan keeps it in great shape. For a limited time, recurring clients get a reduced rate on every visit.

Condo cleaning in Plano and beyond

Plano condos, from the Legacy area out west to east and central Plano, often come with stone counters, stainless appliances and hardwood or tile floors. We use professional-grade products that are gentle on surfaces, and we're happy to use your preferred stone or wood cleaner instead. Leave it out and note it in your booking.

Small-business care

Every team member is background checked, we're 5.0-star rated on Google, and our English-speaking cleaners make it easy to explain how you like things done. We're open seven days a week, 8:30 AM–7:30 PM, and payment is collected after the clean is complete.

Is apartment cleaning priced differently?

Pricing is based on your home's square footage, so a one-bedroom apartment isn't priced like a four-bedroom house. You'll see your price before you book.

Do I need to be home?

No. Many renters leave a key with a neighbor, use a lockbox or share an entry code. Include instructions in your booking notes.

Can you clean before my lease inspection?

Yes. Book a move-out clean and add any cleaning items from your lease to your booking notes.

Do you clean townhomes too?

Yes. We clean townhomes, condos, apartments and single-family homes.
